final_claim.narrative: A temporal reachability check with the required max inter-event delay of 600 returned no route from 1800 to 1115 within [48286,86685] (step_01), so a genuine time-respecting cascade under the 600-unit constraint is not present. A route does exist if the max-wait constraint is relaxed (step_02), showing that temporal ordering alone (without the 600-unit limit) can connect them, but those hops have much larger waiting times and do not satisfy the cascade criterion.
